acceptanceCriteria: A fixture citing an unchanged file with no better anchored source emits no CEM-V1-081 warning.
A fixture with an available anchored citation that cites a weaker tier still warns.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1527 (testprov-1021w). Lanes #1524 and #1527 both saw dogfood-check emit CEM-V1-081 tier-below-anchored warnings on every hunk whose citation points at an unchanged file, including test hunks. Expected: a warning only when the cited evidence is genuinely weaker than an available anchored citation. Actual: a warning on every such hunk, which hides real ones.

title: dogfood-check warns tier-below-anchored (CEM-V1-081) on every hunk cited from an unchanged file
